Definition: Abihail or Abichail, the name of three Israelites and two Israelitesses
BiblicalUsage: Abihail = "my father is might"; 1) a Levite in Moses's time; 2) a Gadite; 3) father of Esther; 4) wife of Abishur; 5) wife of Rehoboam
